requirements.quote: Clean up after yourself and delete `/mnt/volume/river` entirely.
Each line consists of two columns separated by a single space:
The second column is the full artifact filename exactly as it appears in `list.txt`.
Lines must be ordered primarily by descending frequency; for artifacts with the same frequency, order them alphabetically (ASCII) by their full name.

check.cmd: [ "$(cat /home/user/project/reports/artifact_frequency.log)" = "$(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' /home/user/project/artifacts/list.txt | LC_ALL=C sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $1" "$2}' | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1nr -k2,2)" ]

requirements.quote: No header line, no trailing blank lines, and each line must end with a single newline character (Unix LF).
